data.value: 0: square corners. Available in Rectangle mode. Rounding is limited to half the shortest side.

data.name: FramingHelp
data.value: Zoom and framing move the image inside the overlay without moving the overlay itself. The mouse wheel over the overlay also adjusts zoom.

data.name: MoveHelp
data.value: Drag the overlay to move it. Use its bottom handle to resize it. Double-click to open the controls.

data.name: Hotkey
data.value: Ctrl + Shift + F9: hide / show overlay

data.name: HotkeyHelp
data.value: Works from other applications even when settings are closed. The webcam stays active while the overlay is hidden.

data.name: TrayHelp
data.value: Pastille stays in the notification area near the clock. Right-click its icon for Settings, hide/show overlay, or Quit. Closing this window does not quit Pastille.

data.name: Footer
data.value: Native ARM64 / x64 · local webcam · no recording or microphone access
